messages:
Priya S: Hi team :wave: I'm Priya, new ML infra eng starting this week. Quick access q: I need Console access to staging and the ability to toggle feature flags for a short POC. Who do I ask and what info do you need? My SSO email is priya.s@redwoodinc.com
Maya (onboard): welcome Priya! :tada: We usually give new hires console-staging-read by default. For flag toggles you need a maintainer role. @Jamal (infra) can you advise on the fast path for a 2-week POC?
Jamal (infra): hey Priya — welcome. For staging I can grant 'console-staging-admin' or just 'feature-flag-maintainer-staging' depending on scope. For prod/long-lived FF admin we require the infra-access form + security signoff. Link: https://redwood-internal/infra/access-requests
Jamal (infra): Minimal info we need in the form:
```
- requester_email: priya.s@redwoodinc.com
- team: llama-inference
- resources: Console > Staging > Feature flags (kv-cache-opt)
- justification: POC toggles and canary rule for model routing
- duration: 2 weeks
```
Maya (onboard): for speed, if you only need staging toggles for the POC we can skip the full ticket and I can add you to 'feature-flag-maintainer-staging' now. Just confirm team + duration.
Priya S: thanks! Team = llama-inference, duration = 2 weeks. I need to flip 'kv-cache-opt' and create a canary rule to test routing for small traffic slice. Won't touch prod.
Sasha (security): quick note — please make sure no customer PII is stored in flags or rollout rules. If the canary references datasets, keep them synthetic. Also cc me on the form so we can close the exception.
Jamal (infra): sounds good. I'll grant 'feature-flag-maintainer-staging' for 14 days and attach approval to the request log. Expect it within 30–45m.
Jamal (infra): Console path to validate after access: Console > Staging > Environments > Feature flags > kv-cache-opt. You can click 'Impersonate' to preview a target user. If you need a short CLI snippet to list flags: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood/api/flags```
Priya S: perfect, thanks all! Will avoid prod and keep Sasha in the loop.
InfraBot: Access change logged: user=priya.s@redwoodinc.com granted=feature-flag-maintainer-staging expires=2026-04-14 by=jamal.infra :lock:
